subject: Can I used R/qtl2 with in-house generated mouse line with 4 parental strains?

messages.author: ed2d7c4c3776606d
messages.subject: Can I used R/qtl2 with in-house generated mouse line with 4 parental strains?
parts:
Hi guys,

A four-way advanced intercross line was generated and
there are dozens of phenotypes are available.
I wonder if one can use R/qtl2 to do full QTL analysis....

A colleague told me that R/qtl2 can be used only with
"the mice stored in R/qtl2 associated database".
Is that true? Sorry is the question is silly.


Thank you.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Can I used R/qtl2 with in-house generated mouse line with 4 parental strains?
parts:
The goal of R/qtl2 is to be able to handle any kind of multi-parent population. But it does have specific requirements for data input files, and it’s likely that some work will be done to reformat the data.

See https://kbroman.org/qtl2/assets/vignettes/input_files.html

karl
